blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
An organisational structure is the framework that shows how a company is built. It defines who reports to whom, how teams work together, and where decisions are made.

Some companies use a traditional hierarchy, with clear levels from the CEO down to the entry roles. Others prefer flatter models, with fewer layers and more autonomy in each team.

There is no perfect structure. The right model depends on the size of the company, the type of business and the culture it wants to build. HR is often asked to redesign the structure when the company grows or changes direction.

items.q: According to the text, what does an organisational structure define?
options: The company's annual budget
Who reports to whom and where decisions are made
The products the company sells
The salary of each employee
items.why: "It defines who reports to whom, how teams work together, and where decisions are made."

items.q: What is the difference between a hierarchy and a flatter model?
options: A hierarchy has clear levels; a flatter model has fewer layers and more autonomy
A hierarchy is cheaper to run
A flatter model only works in large companies
A flatter model has more layers
items.why: "a traditional hierarchy, with clear levels… flatter models, with fewer layers and more autonomy."

items.q: According to the text, what does the right structure depend on?
options: The number of offices the company has
The size, the type of business and the culture
The structure used by competitors
The opinion of the CEO alone
items.why: "The right model depends on the size of the company, the type of business and the culture it wants to build."

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: HR may be asked to redesign the structure over time
The best structure depends on the company's context
Flatter models give teams more autonomy
There is one perfect structure that works for every company
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz claramente "There is no perfect structure" — o autor discordaria de uma estrutura ideal única.

items.q: The text suggests that a company's structure is…
options: fixed once it is created
something that can change as the company grows or changes direction
decided only by the finance team
the same in every industry
items.why: Inferência: "HR is often asked to redesign the structure when the company grows or changes direction" — a estrutura evolui.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falando com a liderança sobre a reestruturação. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Thanks for making the time. As you know, three departments are going to be merged into one, and I want to walk you through how the new structure has been designed.

First, the reporting lines. At the moment we have three managers and three separate teams. In the new model, all three teams will be led by one head of department, and a single reporting line will be created. That should remove a lot of the duplication we see today.

Second, autonomy. We are not simply adding another layer. The team leaders will still be given the freedom to make day-to-day decisions. Only the bigger calls will be escalated to the new head.

Now, I know change like this makes people nervous. Let me be clear: no roles are being cut in this restructuring. The headcount stays the same. What changes is how the teams are organised, not how many people we have.

Once the design is signed off, it will be rolled out over the next two months. HR will support each team through the transition, and we will review how it is working after ninety days.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What change to the reporting lines does James describe?
options: All three teams will be led by one head of department
A new layer of managers will be added
Each team will keep its own manager
The teams will report directly to the CEO
items.why: "all three teams will be led by one head of department, and a single reporting line will be created."

items.q: What does James say about the team leaders' autonomy?
options: They will decide everything, including the big calls
They will still make day-to-day decisions; only bigger calls are escalated
They will report to two managers each
They will lose all decision-making power
items.why: "The team leaders will still be given the freedom to make day-to-day decisions. Only the bigger calls will be escalated."

items.q: What does James say about the headcount?
options: It will be decided after ninety days
New roles will be added to the merged team
It will be reduced during the restructuring
No roles are being cut; the headcount stays the same
items.why: "no roles are being cut in this restructuring. The headcount stays the same."

items.q: Why does James mention that 'no roles are being cut'?
options: To explain why the budget will grow
To reassure people who are nervous about the change
To criticise the previous structure
To announce a new hiring plan
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "I know change like this makes people nervous" antes — a fala serve para tranquilizar a equipe.

items.q: What can we infer about James's approach to the change?
options: He wants to keep the details secret from the teams
He plans it carefully and wants to support people through it
He is against the merger
He expects the change to happen overnight
items.why: Inferência: ele explica o desenho, promete apoio do RH e uma revisão em 90 dias — abordagem planejada e cuidadosa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "In a strict hierarchy, every decision has to go up several levels first." A hierarchy is…
options: a temporary project group
a team with no manager
a shared office space
a system of clear levels of authority
items.why: Hierarchy = hierarquia: níveis claros de autoridade, do topo à base.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Each analyst has one manager, so the ___ is very clear."
options: layer
headcount
reporting line
autonomy
items.why: Reporting line = linha de reporte: mostra a quem cada pessoa responde.

items.q: "They moved to a flat structure to speed up decisions." A flat structure has…
options: many levels of management
few layers and more autonomy for teams
no managers at all, ever
one manager for the whole company
items.why: Flat structure = estrutura horizontal: poucas camadas e mais autonomia.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "After the merger, the total ___ stayed the same — no one lost their job."
options: headcount
hierarchy
matrix
span of control
items.why: Headcount = número de funcionários; ficou igual porque ninguém foi demitido.

items.q: Span of control refers to…
options: the total budget of a department
how many offices a company has
how many people one manager leads
the number of products in a line
items.why: Span of control = amplitude de controle: quantas pessoas um gestor lidera diretamente.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem em projetos de reestruturação. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The head of HR still has to sign off on the new structure." To sign off on means to…
options: postpone indefinitely
formally approve
discuss informally
reject completely
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new model over the next two months." To roll out means to…
options: explain it to the board
keep it secret
cancel step by step
implement it in stages
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two managers pushed back on the merger." They…
options: forgot to read it
rewrote it themselves
resisted or disagreed with it
approved it at once
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "The team agreed on the plan but never followed through." They…
options: documented it in detail
failed to carry it to completion
carried it to completion
delegated it to HR
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado; aqui, não levaram.

items.q: "When one team is merged into another, roles sometimes overlap." This means the roles…
options: become more senior
cover some of the same work
disappear completely
move to another office
items.why: Overlap = sobrepor-se: duas funções cobrem parte do mesmo trabalho.
